instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe unless the script inputs specify otherwise.
indicators: Inputs (source declarations): UseHAcandles = input(true, title="Use Heikin Ashi Candles in Algo Calculations"); ts_bars = input(20, minval=1, title="Tenkan-Sen Bars"); ks_bars = input(50, minval=1, title="Kijun-Sen Bars"); ssb_bars = input(120, minval=1, title="Senkou-Span B Bars"); cs_offset = input(30, minval=1, title="Chikou-Span Offset"); ss_offset = input(30, minval=1, title="Senkou-Span Offset"); long_entry = input(true, title="Long Entry"); short_entry = input(true, title="Short Entry"); fromDay = input(defval = 1, title = "From Day", minval = 1, maxval = 31); fromMonth = input(defval = 1, title = "From Month", minval = 1, maxval = 12); fromYear = input(defval = 2019, title = "From Year", minval = 1970); toDay = input(defval = 31, title = "To Day", minval = 1, maxval = 31); toMonth = input(defval = 12, title = "To Month", minval = 1, maxval = 12); toYear = input(defval = 2021, title = "To Year", minval = 1970) | Indicator calls: sma(Difference, vollength); lowest(len); highest(len); rma(gain, 14); rma(loss, 14)
exit: Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.close("Long", when=bearish and not short_entry and time_cond); Source submits this exit order from the surrounding strategy flow: strategy.close("Short", when=bullish and not long_entry and time_cond)
position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Higher-timeframe/security or repaint behavior requires independent causal review.
